name: iso_categorical
definition: A volume rendering method for categorical labels that previously marched along view rays in fixed steps (default relative_step_size 0.8 voxel) and tested only the voxel at each sample point, causing sawtooth edges at grazing angles when rays clipped voxel corners between samples.
summary: iso_categorical is a volume rendering method for categorical data that uses exact voxel traversal to eliminate sawtooth artifacts and ensure sampling independence.
